client_decisions.selected_direction: A｜城市通勤 / 城市随身
style_delta: Use more restrained lighting and shadow.

execution_assumptions: Because no platform dimensions were provided, the six required assets are delivered as three 1200 x 1200 ecommerce squares and three 1080 x 1350 social portraits.
Three scene masters are reused across square and portrait layouts to preserve the previously approved low-cost production strategy.
locked_items: Product appearance, interfaces, logo, material texture, and teal color remain unchanged.
Product identity source is inputs/01-product_master.png and is preserved by deterministic compositing rather than generative repainting.
Approved claims only: 12 小时续航；IPX4 防泼水；一体式挂环。
IPX4 is depicted only as a post-drizzle city environment with a dry product surface; no immersion or waterproof extension.
No fictional buttons, ports, lights, clips, or accessories.
Selected direction remains city commute with entryway, café-window, and urban riverside cues.
The current front source does not reveal the integrated loop, so no physical bag-attachment mechanism is invented.
changed_items: Locked client-selected direction A: city commute / city carry.
Replaced the warmer, more decorative direction-board treatment with cool-neutral off-white, concrete gray, and graphite scenes.
Removed decorative labels and slogans; each final asset contains at most one approved claim line.
Increased negative space through clear walls, pale skies, and a 270 px matte header on social portraits.
Generated three no-product background masters with the built-in imagegen tool.
Created a source-RGB-preserving product cutout and composited it into six final assets.
Delivered three ecommerce square assets and three social portrait assets.
unchanged_items: Exact product identity and teal color.
Light urban outdoor tone; no expedition or extreme-adventure imagery.
No physical hanging proof without a visible loop source angle.
conditional_inputs: If a future asset must visibly prove the speaker physically attached to a bag, provide a product angle that clearly shows the integrated loop and its connection method.
